examples.ar: يَرْفَعِ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مِنكُمْ وَالَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ دَرَجَاتٍ.
examples.en: God will raise those who have believed among you and those who were given knowledge, by degrees.

examples.ar: وَقُلِ اعْمَلُوا فَسَيَرَى اللَّهُ عَمَلَكُمْ وَرَسُولُهُ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ.
examples.en: And say, 'Do deeds, for God will see your deeds, and [so, too], His Messenger and the believers.'

examples.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ إِذَا عَمِلَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَمَلًا أَنْ يُتْقِنَهُ.
examples.en: Indeed, God loves that when one of you does a job, they do it perfectly.
Indeed, God orders justice and good conduct.

examples.ar: الْتَّفَكُّرُ فِي مَظَاهِرِ الكَوْنِ يُغَذِّي العَقْلَ البَشَرِيَّ.
examples.en: Reflecting on the manifestations of the universe nourishes the human mind.
Within it is a flowing spring.

examples.ar: وَأَوْفُوا بِالْعَهْدِ ۖ إِنَّ الْعَهْدَ كَانَ مَسْئُولًا.
examples.en: And fulfill the covenant. Indeed, the covenant will be questioned.
And when you have decided, then rely upon God.
